# package nsd

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/nsd"
```

Package nsd imports IEC 61850 namespace definition (NSD) files, the machine-readable form of IEC 61850-7-2, -7-3, -7-4 and their domain extensions defined by IEC 61850-7-7.

[Parse](#func-parse) reads one XML document: a namespace definition (NS), a documentation file (NSDoc), or a service namespace, which is recognized but not modeled yet. [LoadZIP](#func-loadzip), [ReadZIP](#func-readzip), [LoadFile](#func-loadfile) and [LoadDir](#func-loaddir) read whole packages and apply the documentation texts to the namespaces they belong to. [ReadManifest](#func-readmanifest) reads an IECManifest.xml package manifest.

#### Input safety {#hdr-Input_safety}

Inputs are untrusted. Every document is bounded in size, nesting depth and token count, and DOCTYPE declarations are rejected, which also rules out entity expansion. Archives are bounded in entry count, total uncompressed size and compression ratio; absolute names, path traversal, backslashes, duplicate entries (compared case-insensitively) and non-regular entries are rejected. Archives nested inside archives are opened one level deep. Nothing is written to disk.

#### Diagnostics {#hdr-Diagnostics}

The importer does not drop data silently. Elements and attributes it does not model are reported as warnings with their XML path; missing required attributes, invalid values and duplicate definitions are errors. A document with errors is rejected with a [\*model.ValidationError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ValidationError) listing every finding; [WithStrict](#func-withstrict) makes warnings fatal too.

Validation is structural and uses the standard library only: the importer checks the elements and attributes it models and the rules in [Validate](#func-validate), but it does not run an XSD validator.

#### Source material {#hdr-Source_material}

NSD files and their documentation texts are IEC content. This package reads them from files or readers supplied by the caller and never downloads them; see docs/licensing.md for what may be redistributed.

## Constants

```go
const (
	DefaultMaxDocumentSize     = 32 << 20  // 32 MiB per XML document
	DefaultMaxArchiveSize      = 256 << 20 // 256 MiB uncompressed per archive
	DefaultMaxArchiveEntries   = 1024
	DefaultMaxDepth            = 64
	DefaultMaxTokens           = 10_000_000
	DefaultMaxCompressionRatio = 200
)
```

Default safety bounds. They are generous for official NSD packages, whose largest documents are a few MiB, and small enough to stop malicious input early.

```go
const ManifestFileName = "Manifest.xml"
```

ManifestFileName is the file name of the package manifest inside official IEC code component archives. Some packages name it IECManifest.xml instead; both are recognized.

```go
const ManifestNamespace = "http://www.iec.ch/CC/2017/IECManifest"
```

ManifestNamespace is the XML namespace of IEC code component manifests.

```go
const SchemaNamespace2016 = "http://www.iec.ch/61850/2016/NSD"
```

SchemaNamespace2016 is the XML namespace of NSD documents defined by IEC 61850-7-7.

## Functions

### func ApplyDoc

```go
func ApplyDoc(ns *model.Namespace, doc *NSDoc) int
```

ApplyDoc fills the Title and Description fields of every definition in ns from doc and returns the number of texts applied. It modifies ns, so call it before the namespace is added to a catalog.

### func ParseNamespace

```go
func ParseNamespace(r io.Reader, opts ...Option) (*model.Namespace, model.Diagnostics, error)
```

ParseNamespace parses an NS document and returns its namespace. Use [Parse](#func-parse) to accept other document kinds.

### func Supported

```go
func Supported() (elements, attributes []string)
```

Supported returns the element and attribute names the importer models, derived from its decoding structures, sorted. ServiceNS and ApplicableServiceNS content is recognized but not modeled and is not included.

### func Validate

```go
func Validate(ns *model.Namespace) model.Diagnostics
```

Validate checks the structure of one namespace and returns its findings: duplicate definitions, duplicate members and literals, self-inheritance and dependencies on itself.

References to types of other namespaces cannot be checked here; the catalog package checks them when it builds a profile. Parse runs Validate on every NS document it reads.

#### func Parse

```go
func Parse(r io.Reader, opts ...Option) (*Document, error)
```

Parse reads and parses one NSD XML document: a namespace definition (NS), a documentation file (NSDoc), or a service namespace, which is recognized but not modeled.

The input is bounded by the configured size, depth and token limits; DOCTYPE declarations are rejected. A document whose structure has errors, or warnings in strict mode, is rejected with a [\*model.ValidationError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model#ValidationError) that lists every finding.

### type DocumentKind

```go
type DocumentKind int
```

DocumentKind is the kind of an NSD XML document, given by its root element.

```go
const (
	// KindNS is a namespace definition (root element NS).
	KindNS DocumentKind = iota + 1
	// KindNSDoc is a documentation file (root element NSDoc).
	KindNSDoc
	// KindServiceNS is a service namespace definition (root element
	// ServiceNS). Its content is recognized but not modeled yet.
	KindServiceNS
	// KindApplicableServiceNS is an applicable services definition
	// (root element ApplicableServiceNS). Its content is recognized but
	// not modeled yet.
	KindApplicableServiceNS
)
```

Document kinds.

### type Manifest

```go
type Manifest struct {
	// Source names the input, e.g. "package.zip!IECManifest.xml".
	Source string `json:"source,omitempty"`
	// Root is the local name of the root element.
	Root string `json:"root"`
	// Attrs are the attributes of the root element.
	Attrs []Attr `json:"attrs,omitempty"`
	// Elements are all elements below the root, depth first.
	Elements []ManifestElement `json:"elements,omitempty"`
	// SHA256 is the hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the manifest bytes.
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
}
```

Manifest is the content of an IECManifest.xml package manifest.

The manifest format is not modeled field by field yet: the root attributes and every element below the root are kept generically, in document order, so no information is lost until the format has been verified against official packages.

NSDoc is a parsed NSDoc documentation file: the texts referenced by the titleID, descID and presCondArgsID attributes of one namespace, in one language.

The texts are IEC content. Use them at run time; do not redistribute them (see docs/licensing.md).

### type Package

```go
type Package struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Package is the content of one NSD source: a ZIP archive, a directory or a single document. It holds the parsed namespaces, documentation files, the manifest when present, and the diagnostics of the import.

Package implements the source interface of the catalog package through its Namespaces method.

#### func LoadDir

```go
func LoadDir(dir string, opts ...Option) (*Package, error)
```

LoadDir loads every NSD document (.nsd, .snsd, .nsdoc), XSD schema, manifest and ZIP archive (by extension or content) directly inside dir, in name order. Subdirectories are not searched.

#### func LoadFile

```go
func LoadFile(name string, opts ...Option) (*Package, error)
```

LoadFile loads an NSD source from a file: a ZIP archive, recognized by its content whatever its extension (official package names such as "IEC\_61850-7-2.NSD.2007B6.light" may have none), an XSD schema, or a single XML document.

### type Schema

```go
type Schema struct {
	// Source names the input, e.g. "package.zip!NSD.xsd".
	Source string `json:"source"`
	// SHA256 is the hex digest of the XSD document.
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	// TargetNamespace is the targetNamespace of the schema.
	TargetNamespace string `json:"targetNamespace,omitempty"`
	// Elements and Attributes are the declared names, sorted.
	Elements   []string `json:"elements,omitempty"`
	Attributes []string `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
}
```

Schema is the inventory of an XSD file of the NSD format (IEC 61850-7-7): its target namespace and the element and attribute names it declares. It is used to find constructs of an official schema that the importer does not model yet; it is not an XSD validator.

#### func ParseSchema

```go
func ParseSchema(r io.Reader, opts ...Option) (*Schema, error)
```

ParseSchema reads the inventory of one XSD document, under the same size, depth and DTD restrictions as [Parse](#func-parse).

#### func (Schema) Gaps

```go
func (s *Schema) Gaps() (elements, attributes []string)
```

Gaps returns the element and attribute names the schema declares and the importer does not model. Content of such constructs is reported as warnings when it occurs in NSD documents.
